newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade March SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in featureless late trading on Friday due to an absence of consumer demand, traders said.
They said March SIR20 was unchanged at 53.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and Surabaya, at 53.25 fob Palembang and at 53.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"I don't hear of any deals taking place today. The last deal I did was on Wednesday at 53.41 U.S. cents/lb," said one trader.
Traders said they expected the market to remain bearish next week due to sluggish demand and a lack of fresh factors despite the local tight supply.
Some traders said the current wintering did not seem to affect the price because buyers might have enough stocks so they did not need to make fresh purchases.
Some traders earlier said the fall in rubber futures in Tokyo on Thursday had dampened the market sentiment and they expected a downtrend next week.
